tls.description: Connect over TLS. Implied by tlsCa and tlsCert.

tlsCa.description: PEM certificates to trust, instead of the system's.

tlsCert.description: A PEM client certificate, for mutual TLS.

tlsServerName.description: The name to verify the brokers' certificates against, if not their host.

schemaRegistryUrl.description: A Confluent-compatible schema registry. Avro and Protobuf need one.

schemaRegistryUsername.description: A user for the schema registry's basic authentication. Unset: none.

format.description: How values and keys are encoded. Avro and Protobuf register each stream's schemas under <topic>-value and <topic>-key.

namespace.description: Used when the pipeline names no namespace: topics are named namespace.table.

partitions.description: Created topics' partitions. Default: the brokers'.

replicationFactor.description: Created topics' replication factor. Default: the brokers'.

markerTopic.description: The compacted topic each epoch's transaction writes its marker to. Created if missing.

transactionalIdPrefix.description: Transactional IDs are this, the pipeline and the producer's slot.

tombstones.description: Follow each delete with a tombstone for its key, for compacted topics.
